rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL still owns the freshest idiosyncratic catalyst stack in the majors. U.S. spot Solana ETFs have logged NET INFLOWS on EVERY July trading day of 2026 — the only major category positive every session while spot-BTC and spot-ETH ETFs saw outflows in the same window. Supporting the bid: Grayscale cut its Solana Staking ETF sponsor fee to 0.19% and staking fee to 7% (eff. Jun 25), and 21Shares' TSOL moves to the FTSE Digital Assets Index (eff. Aug 24) — both structural demand tailwinds. The Alpenglow consensus upgrade is lined up as a Q3 activation catalyst. On the tape SOL is firming with a risk-on session (total mkt +1.7% 24h; BTC +~1%, ETH +~1.5%) and entry $78.32 still sits below the $80/$83 resistance shelf, leaving room to run — the asymmetric 'fresh catalyst + relative strength with a definable stop' setup the mandate prefers.
positions.driver: Hold/re-establish SOL. Rolled +$186.76 from yesterday's SOL leg into capital. SOL keeps the cleanest asymmetric payoff vs runners-up: BTC (~$66,312) is the flow-leading, lower-beta PROTECTIVE major but carries no fresh idiosyncratic catalyst and a lower expected next-24h payoff; ETH (~$1,935) is today's best % gainer (+~1.5%) but remains the 6-month structural laggard with ETF outflows and repeated stalls below key EMAs — a live sell-the-news risk. SOL's every-session ETF inflow streak + Q3 Alpenglow + fee/benchmark tailwinds, plus firming relative strength with entry below the $80/$83 shelf, give it the best risk-adjusted 24h edge.
positions.risks: SOL is the higher-beta major, so it falls hardest if the risk-on tape rolls over — sentiment is still Extreme Fear and SOL trades ~57% below its Oct-2025 ETF-launch price, so the ETF-inflow narrative coexists with a heavy downtrend. ETF inflows are small in absolute dollars and can flip to outflows on broad-market weakness (the stated main risk). Technically SOL faces stacked resistance at $80/$83/$90 and has repeatedly failed near $74-75 support; a decisive break of $74-75 invalidates the thesis. Hard stop $70.49 (-10%, higher-beta rule) below the support shelf with wick room.
